notes: Mac build of AdTrapper v11.12 (Mac re-port of PC v11.12): the five owner fixes. Child windows (Guided Clean, Settings, USB guide, Removal History, Disclaimer, Report details) are built by the app's own queue pump - the same pattern the Background Check window has always used - so they open at their real size: no more 66x20 slivers in the corner. The main window opens at about 7/8 x 3/4 of the screen, centered, and remembers the size + position it was left at. One Settings door (the rail-foot word; the doors-row gear is gone). 'No store record' replaces the misleading 'Preinstalled' install-source label (engine and factory cap untouched). And the feed fix: every HTTPS fetch now builds its SSL context by a fallback chain (default, then the macOS system bundle /etc/ssl/cert.pem, then certifi), so a Mac whose python.org Python never had its certificates wired connects again - verification always on. Automatic updates, same face, same verdict law, disclaimer v3.1. (6) Factory apps are remembered per phone: once an app is proven to have come with the phone, it stays protected on that phone even if a later scan's signals miss it -- a factory app can never flip to removable by accident. (7) Every flagged app now shows WHY it is flagged right on its row -- no need to open it first. (8) The window now opens at HALF the screen, centered and clear of the dock, and remembers the size you leave it at. (9) The writing shows ONCE, on the row itself, and wraps inside the window at any size -- never cut off at the edge; and EVERY app shows its reading on its row without a click, clean apps included. (10) Stronger factory proof: an app whose program file sits in a factory part of the phone, or whose system flag is set, counts as factory and is remembered per phone the same way. (11) The hand pointer is gone -- the normal arrow everywhere. (12) The refresh button beside Source is bigger and easy to see. (13) The results rows are rebuilt as one column: the app name and its verdict sit on one line, and the writing sits directly underneath at the row's full width, re-wrapped at the window's real width every time the window changes size -- it can no longer be squeezed into a strip at the edge or run off the side at smaller windows. (14) Every scan now writes one extra log line per flagged app showing the raw factory evidence (where its program file lives, who installed it, its system flags), so a factory app that is not recognised can be diagnosed from the log alone. (15) At the small opening size the bottom totals bar and the summary line under the heading now stay whole: the totals rearrange into two rows so the Undo and Remove buttons are never cut off or pushed out of the window, and the summary line uses a shorter form of the same counts; at full size everything reads exactly as before. (16) Freeze-hardening revision (rev-4.3): a watchdog now guards the window while scans run and logs any stall, so a busy scan cannot silently lock the app. This is the exact build verified running on the shop MacBook Pro.
